jobs.description:

Access to a broad network of clients, including Fortune 100 firms and mid-market organizations.
Opportunity to work on challenging and impactful enterprise technology projects.
Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, and 401K.
Supportive and experienced recruiting team to help guide your career.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Project Manager based in Brazil.

This role combines technical project leadership with hands-on software development expertise to guide projects from planning through delivery.

You’ll work at the intersection of business requirements and engineering execution, translating needs into clear technical plans and actionable tasks.

The position requires enough technical depth to understand code, architecture, APIs, databases, integrations, and development workflows.

You’ll coordinate developers, designers, QA specialists, and other technical contributors while keeping projects aligned with scope, timelines, and quality standards.

The role also involves identifying risks, resolving blockers, facilitating Agile ceremonies, and maintaining clear communication with stakeholders.

You’ll contribute directly to technical discussions and decisions rather than operating solely as an administrative project manager.

This is a fully remote opportunity suited to an organized, analytical professional who can combine technical judgment with strong project leadership.

Accountabilities

Lead technical projects through the full lifecycle, from requirements gathering and planning through development, testing, deployment, and post-launch support.
Translate business requirements into clear technical requirements, user stories, specifications, and development tasks.
Create project plans, establish timelines, assign responsibilities, and manage priorities across multiple concurrent projects.
Coordinate developers, designers, QA specialists, and other technical contributors to keep delivery on track.
Review technical solutions and provide informed input on architecture, integrations, database structures, APIs, and development approaches.
Participate in code reviews and technical discussions when required.
Monitor development progress, identify blockers and risks, and work with teams to resolve technical and operational issues.
Facilitate sprint planning, backlog prioritization, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and other Agile activities.
Ensure projects follow appropriate development, testing, documentation, security, and deployment processes.
Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, decisions, and delivery expectations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Maintain accurate project documentation covering requirements, timelines, technical decisions, dependencies, and status updates.
Support troubleshooting and incident resolution for existing systems when needed.
Identify and implement improvements to project management and software development processes.

Requirements

4+ years of professional software development experience.
2+ years of experience managing technical or software development projects.
Strong hands-on programming experience with one or more languages or frameworks such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, PHP, Java, C#, React, Node.js, or similar technologies.
Ability to read, understand, review, and discuss code with software developers.
Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, system architecture, databases, APIs, integrations, version control, testing, and deployment.
Experience managing Agile or Scrum-based development teams.
Experience with project management platforms such as Jira, ClickUp, Monday.com, Asana, or similar tools.
Working knowledge of GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, or comparable version-control platforms.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a practical approach to identifying and resolving delivery challenges.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear information for non-technical stakeholders.
Strong organization and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and dependencies.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud is a plus.
Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, application security, and infrastructure management is advantageous.
Experience managing distributed or remote development teams is desirable.
Experience working with external clients and gathering technical requirements is a plus.
Relevant project management or Agile certification is an advantage.

Benefits

Fully remote work arrangement.
Opportunity to combine software development expertise with technical project leadership.
End-to-end ownership of software projects from requirements through deployment and post-launch support.
Direct involvement in technical architecture, APIs, databases, integrations, and development decisions.
Collaboration with developers, designers, QA specialists, and business stakeholders.
Opportunity to improve development processes, documentation, accountability, and delivery practices.
Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies and modern project management and development tools.
Opportunity to work across multiple technical projects and contribute to meaningful delivery improvements.

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

jobs.title: Project Manager, PMO Operations
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Project Manager, PMO Operations supports the Program Management Office for one of Astreya's largest dedicated global clients. This is an operations-focused project management role rather than a traditional delivery project management role. Instead of owning a single project lifecycle, you will keep a portfolio of program actions, initiatives, and workstreams moving across a global, cross-functional organization, and you will own the communications that keep that organization aligned.

You will work across functional groups, driving small to medium initiatives from intake through closure. The role suits a highly organized project manager who is comfortable operating with limited direction, building processes where none exists yet, collaborating between teams, and writing clearly for a senior and global audience.

Key Responsibilities

Own tracking and closure of program action items across global delivery teams, maintaining schedules, owners, and due dates, and escalating risks to the Senior Manager before they affect commitments.
Drive small to medium initiatives end to end, including scoping, planning, stakeholder alignment, status reporting, and formal closure.
Provide project coordination and communications capacity as needed. This includes building trackers, reporting, meeting cadences, and templates, documenting emerging processes, and taking on whatever coordination work the workstream needs to become self-sufficient.
Draft, edit, and publish internal communications across established channels, maintaining a predictable cadence and adapting tone for audiences ranging from frontline delivery teams to senior leadership.
Coordinate intake and information flow between teams, ensuring requests are routed, tracked, and closed out.
Produce recurring reports on program health, action status, and initiative progress for senior leadership and client review.
Identify and implement improvements to PMO processes, templates, and communication practices.

What Success Looks Like

Six months in, a successful hire is:

Communicating credibly with delivery leads, Account Management, the VMO, and client stakeholders, adjusting register for each audience without needing to be coached on it.
Raising questions early rather than sitting on ambiguity, including asking the obvious question that nobody else in the room has asked yet.
Identifying what needs to happen and starting it, rather than waiting to be assigned work.
Trying an approach, recognizing quickly when it is not working, and changing course openly instead of defending the original plan.

Qualifications And Skills

Bachelor's degree and five or more years of experience in project management within corporate IT, managed services, or a comparable services environment.
Demonstrated experience in a dedicated or embedded client support model, with sound judgment about client-facing communication and escalation.
Experience standing up a new team, function, or workstream, including building the trackers, cadences, and reporting that did not previously exist, and operating effectively while processes are still taking shape.
Strong business writing ability, with experience drafting communications for a global audience.
Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively across many different functions and levels, from technical delivery teams to senior leadership and client contacts, and to build working relationships in a matrixed organization.
Proven ability to prioritize a varied workload independently and meet deadlines in a fast moving environment.
Proficiency with Google Workspace, AI tools, and work management or project tracking tools.
Willingness to maintain regular working overlap with US time zones to support global stakeholders.

jobs.description:
Job Title

Project Manager

Job Description Summary

Provides professional project management experience to designated projects and assignments at a client site, campus, and facilities.

Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY

Provides professional project management experience to designated projects and assignments at a client site, campus, and facilities. Interacts with client representatives onsite, receives direction and coordinates with the property or facility management team. Monitors and coordinates the execution of the various services and processes relating to client contracted agreements for project management and tenant improvements. Works in collaboration with the assigned account manager, building or facility management team, clients, owners and others.

Essential Functions And Responsibilities

Prepare agendas, develop and maintain master project budgets and timelines as required for each project and project phase to ensure overall project objectives and client needs are met. Keep building management apprised of progress at all times
Prepare and coordinate project reports and drawing reviews for clients, property/facility management team, and project team (as applicable) at conceptual, schematic, design development and construction phases of project
Assist in the selection, contracting process and oversight of consultants and construction teams as necessary for each project
Review requisitions, change orders and other invoices associated with the project and confer with client and property management on costs and impacts
Support the marketing of services to clients as requested
Adhere to corporate, building, and client policies and procedures
Cooperate with other building/facility personnel to achieve goals and objectives as to quality, service, cost and profit
Report to immediate supervisor major problems and findings and results achieved with recommendations
Advise and obtain the necessary approvals from the appropriate members of management of potential organizational changes, actions that might require additional commitments, and the need for expenditures in excess of approved budget
Adhere to government laws and regulations and established rulings of government authorities, including building codes, safety regulations, etc.
Maintain high qualitative and quantitative standards of work performance
Strive constantly to improve skill and work knowledge; keep up to date in the field of specialization

KEY COMPETENCIES

Client Focus
Communication Proficiency (oral and written)
Relationship Management
Leadership
Multi-Tasking
Technical Proficiency
Consultation
Organization Skills
Time Management

IMPORTANT EDUCATION

B.S. Degree in Engineering, Architecture

Important Experience

Minimum of 5 years directly related experience in an engineering/construction project accountability role
Minimum of 5 years project management experience required
Minimum of 3 years of supervisory experience in a project management capacity especially experience in leading, motivating, and developing employees
Hands-on experience with tenant improvement construction projects preferred

jobs.title: IT PROJECT MANAGER
jobs.description:
The Information Technology (IT) Project Manager is responsible for all phases of project management in the planning and tactical execution of technology initiatives. The IT Project Manager assists business units in improving the way they deliver services by understanding their needs, analyzing existing business processes, translating change and implementation requests into IT project requirements, and overseeing and managing those projects and implementations to successful completion. This position is responsible for managing project expectations, defining project scope and deliverables, communicating the functional requirements and dependencies to the relevant IT team members, developing project plans, and creating relevant documentation to track progress.

Essential Job Functions

Manage projects related to the development and implementation of new systems and applications including the development of project plans, management of project timelines and ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Lead internal project planning and development of solutions for client needs.
Identify and oversee business process-driven technology improvements.
Work with third-party partners or solutions in developing or implementing solutions.
Provide pre-sales technical consulting by participating in online demonstrations and conference calls for enterprise-level SaaS solutions.
Define technical requirements, outline use-case(s), resources and cost to implement solutions, and contribute to defining the project charter for opportunities to support our mission, automation, efficiency and simplification.
Understand, document and monitor application layering dependencies (User-Interface, Deployment, Public Interface, Application Domain, Application Infrastructure, Technical Frameworks, and Platforms) and application component dependencies.
Understand and monitor impacts to and dependencies between existing applications and environments.
Define and direct proof-of-concept tasks for proposed architectural interactions.
Work closely with departments to respond to proposals and RFQ’s to ensure that all technical information and recommendations address the requirements.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and design solutions including identifying gaps in existing systems and processes and recommending solutions to address those gaps.
Utilize a “Cloud First Approach”, Cloud-Based Systems may include Microsoft 365 or Google, enterprise ticketing systems, document management systems and other cloud-based low-code workflow automation platforms.
Analyze business requirements and demands to assess design/technology alternatives and propose solutions.
Collaborate with other teams and vendors to develop and implement new solutions to meet business requirements.
Analyze existing IT processes, identify inefficiencies and implement data-driven strategies to optimize system performance, reduce costs and enhance overall operational efficiency.
Utilize methodologies like Lean and Six Sigma to drive measurable improvements across IT systems and services including data collection, process mapping, root cause analysis, change management and collaboration with cross-functional teams to implement improvements and monitor their effectiveness.
Provide technical support by participating in vendor support calls for enterprise-level technical issues or upgrades.
Facilitate, present and lead technical discussions with technical subject matter experts as well as customers and other stakeholders.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities (Competencies)

Excellent communication skills both orally and written.
Experience with technologies and best practices across multiple platforms.
Ability to work well under pressure and manage time effectively, in a constantly changing environment.
Ability to take initiative to develop new strategies and outside-the-box ideas.
Ability to work independently or in a team.
Ability to establish and maintain working relationships with individuals at all levels.
Ability to efficiently utilize Microsoft Office.
Self-starter and goal oriented.
Strong interpersonal skills with a mechanical aptitude that allows for effective communication of the product to our customers.
Manage and prioritize multiple tasks and projects in parallel in a time sensitive environment.

Education And Experience

A Bachelor’s Degree in computer science, Project Management or Engineering preferred. Other degree fields and related experience will be considered.
A minimum of five (5) years related experience is required for this position.
Project Management Professional Certification preferred.

Base Compensation Range
: $79,949 - $125,049 annually

Variable Compensation Range
: Incentive bonus eligibility up to 12% of gross annual salary base on company performance.

jobs.title: Subcontract Technical Project Manager (Science/Engineering Project Leader 2/3)
jobs.description:
What You Will Do

This position will be filled at either the Science/Engineering Project Leader 2 or Science/Engineering Project Leader 3 level, depending on the skills of the selected candidate. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if the candidate is hired at the higher level.

The Space Systems Assurance and Implementation (ISR-7) Group is seeking a motivated and collaborative Science/Engineering Project Leader to join our team. Los Alamos National Laboratory's Intelligence and Space Research (ISR) Division designs, builds, delivers, and operates innovative ground-air-space-based measurement systems that support scientific discovery and national security missions. ISR's more than 400 instruments fly on over 200 satellites, including numerous NASA missions such as Voyager and the most recent Mars Rover missions.

Science/Engineering Project Leader 2 ($106,400-$176,000)

In this role, you will serve as an integral member of a program conducting suborbital flight tests. The primary responsibility is to manage a variety of subcontracts for efforts such as launch services, flight vehicle engineering, telemetry and communications, simulations and analyses, and additional services needed to execute these missions. While the successful applicant does not need to have an intimate understanding of all engineering disciplines relating to a subcontract, they must possess enough awareness of the tasks and processes to provide proper technical oversight and ensure the subcontract work scope is executed in accordance with project, mission, and institutional requirements. A technical background in one or more related disciplines is highly desirable.

Science/Engineering Project Leader 3 ($128,000-$215,900)

At the higher level, this position will execute the same scope of responsibilities as at the lower level but will be expected to do so with greater independence, autonomy, and agency in decision-making. This increased responsibility comes from greater professional experience, education, and technical credentials. In addition, the SEPL3 will integrate more fully into the project leadership team, helping to shape mission strategy and execution.

What You Need

Minimum Job Requirements:

Working knowledge and experience as a technical contributor in a science and engineering environment.
Working knowledge of and experience executing subcontracting processes, including developing statements of work.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical and nontechnical information effectively with colleagues, suppliers, and project leadership.
Experience managing supplier, subcontractor, or vendor activities, including the review and confirmation of technical milestones.
Ability to independently manage competing priorities, take strategic initiative, and resolve complex problems creatively, efficiently, and diplomatically.
Proficiency with business and operations systems and standard software applications (e.g., Microsoft, Adobe).
Ability to gain a DOE Q clearance.

Additional Job Requirements for Science/Engineering Project Leader 3:

Advanced knowledge of and demonstrated experience executing subcontracting processes, including developing statements of work.
Advanced knowledge of and demonstrated experience in project management principles and practices, including ensuring resources are available to complete project deliverables within scope, schedules, and budgets.
Significant experience developing and sustaining effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Education/Experience at lower level:
Position requires a bachelor's degree in a science- or engineering-related field from an accredited institution and 5 years directly related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience directly related to the occupation.

Education/Experience at higher level:
Position requires a bachelor's degree in a science- or engineering-related field from an accredited institution and 8 years directly related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience directly related to the occupation. At this level an advanced degree is typically expected.

Desired Qualifications:

Experience with procurement and support tools such as SAP Ariba, Oracle, Jira, Confluence, homegrown software, or other procurement or supplier management systems.
Current project management certification (e.g., PMP, CAPM, or equivalent).
Working knowledge of process improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent).
Experience working in a national laboratory or federal environment.

Note to Applicants:

Please provide a detailed cover letter outlining specific examples of how you meet the minimum job requirements and any desired qualifications.

Physical Requirements:

Physical movement between buildings located primarily within a half-mile radius, which may include movement across uneven and/or inclined ground.

Physical movement within large interior facility spaces and corridors, which may require travel up and down stairs.

Direct interaction with hardware, equipment, and instruments in office and laboratory environments.

Work Environment:

Work Location:
The work location for this position is hybrid and is located in Los Alamos. Hybrid is defined as working partially onsite/partially offsite but within 2 hours ground commute of this location. All work locations are at the discretion of management and can change at any time with appropriate notice.

Position commitment:
Regular appointment employees are required to serve a period of continuous service in their current position in order to be eligible to apply for posted jobs throughout the Laboratory. If an employee has not served the time required, they may only apply for Laboratory jobs with the documented approval of their Division Leader. The position commitment for this position is 1 year.

Note to Applicants:

Due to federal restrictions contained in the current National Defense Authorization Act, citizens of the People's Republic of China-including the special administrative regions of Hong Kong and Macau-as well as citizens of the Islamic Republic of Iran, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (North Korea), and the Russian Federation, who are not Lawful Permanent Residents ("green card" holders) are prohibited from accessing facilities that support the mission, functions, and operations of national security laboratories and nuclear weapons production facilities, which includes Los Alamos National Laboratory.

Where You Will Work

Located in beautiful northern New Mexico, Los Alamos National Laboratory (LANL) is a multidisciplinary research institution engaged in strategic science on behalf of national security. Our generous benefits package includes:

PPO or High Deductible medical insurance with the same large nationwide network
Dental and vision insurance
Free basic life and disability insurance
Paid childbirth and parental leave
Award-winning 401(k) (6% matching plus 3.5% annually)
Learning opportunities and tuition assistance
Flexible schedules and time off (PTO and holidays)
Onsite gyms and wellness programs
Extensive relocation packages (outside a 50 mile radius)

Additional Details

Directive 206.2
- Employment with Triad requires a favorable decision by NNSA indicating employee is suitable under NNSA Supplemental Directive 206.2. Please note that this requirement applies only to citizens of the United States. Foreign nationals are subject to a similar requirement under DOE Order 142.3A.

Clearance: Q
(Position will be cleared to this level). Selected applicants will be subject to a background investigation conducted by or on behalf of the Federal Government, and must meet eligibility requirements* for access to classified matter. This position requires a Q clearance. and obtaining such clearance requires US Citizenship except in extremely rare circumstances. Dependent upon the position, additional authorization to access classified information may be required, which may or may not be available to dual citizens. Receipt of a Q clearance and additional access authorization ultimately is a decision of the Federal Government and not of Triad.

Eligibility requirements: To obtain a clearance, an individual must be at least 18 years of age; U.S. citizenship is required except in very limited circumstances. See DOE Order 472.2 for additional information.

New-Employment Drug Test:
The Laboratory requires successful applicants to complete a new-employment drug test and maintains a substance abuse policy that includes random drug testing. Although New Mexico and other states have legalized the use of marijuana, use and possession of marijuana remain illegal under federal law. A positive drug test for marijuana will result in termination of employment, even if the use was pre-offer.

Regular position:
Term status Laboratory employees applying for regular-status positions are converted to regular status.

Equal Opportunity:
Los Alamos National Laboratory is an equal opportunity employer. All employment practices are based on qualification and merit, without regard to protected categories such as race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, age, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status or spousal affiliation, physical or mental disability, medical conditions, pregnancy, status as a protected veteran, genetic information, or citizenship within the limits imposed by federal, state, and local laws and regulations. The Laboratory is also committed to making our workplace accessible to individuals with disabilities and will provide reasonable accommodations, upon request, for individuals to participate in the application and hiring process. To request such an accommodation, please send an email to applyhelp@lanl.gov or call (505)-664-6947.

Reports to the Technology Infrastructure & Operations (TIO) Portfolio Manager. Delivers a cross-functional change management role that requires interaction with management and key stakeholders across Technology and other impacted lines-of-business (LOB). At the project level, coordinates across the LOB delivery teams, technology and data management teams, Enterprise Information Security (EIS), the Technology Delivery Office (TDO) and Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO).

Responsibilities

Develop project plans with stakeholder leaders, identifying key milestones and deliverables.
Schedules and facilitate stakeholder meetings, coordinating project plans and gaining consensus.
Prepares reports, presentations, and other documentation as required by LOB stakeholders, the TDO and the EPMO.
Produces and distributes status reporting on project progress, risks, issues, and dependencies.
Ensures projects are on time.
Conducts project deep-dive meetings with the TDO Program Manager to escalate risk/issues timely.
Monitors project spending versus budget.
Develops accurate project spending forecasts each month.
Produces project documentation within the required timeframes in accordance with the standards and governance requirements of the IT Project Delivery (ITPD) Methodology, Agile, Project Spend and Governance Committee, and TDO guidelines.
Work with IT teams to coordinate testing, escalate issues, and assist where necessary to ensure a successful go live.
Coordinates the analysis of business and technical problems including making recommendations to management to help identify methods, procedures, and technologies that enhance recommended solutions and project execution.

A BA/BS degree and/or equivalent work experience

Requires direct experience in business analysis and project leadership and management skills, preferably as a project manager or consultant

Experience managing projects within both agile and waterfall environments.

Ability to work independently

Ability to quickly establish rapport, credibility, trust, and respect throughout the organization at all levels, and be viewed as a team player.

Advanced PowerPoint and strong Excel skills
Ability to organize and conduct effective meetings appropriate for the topic, and facilitate resolution of differing views

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - EMEA
jobs.description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About The Role

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to stand up and support program management for our flagship engagements. This role requires technical credibility, direct customer ownership, and the ability to build structure from scratch in a fast-moving environment.

You will operate across OEM programs and internal delivery teams – translating ambiguous requirements into tracked, executable work, representing Applied Intuition directly with customers and partners, and keeping the EMEA program tightly synchronized with our Sunnyvale headquarters.

At Applied Intuition, You Will

Stand up and run program management – define milestones, own timelines and deliverables, manage sprint and roadmap execution for software development teams through series production
Serve as a point of contact for our customers; translate requirements into tracked engineering work and provide structured, regular updates
Act as the synchronization point between the team, OEM programs, and Sunnyvale – run the recurring cadence with HQ engineering, product, and leadership teams, align technical roadmaps across time zones, and make sure decisions and context travel in both directions
Provide day-to-day operational support to the Vehicle Intelligence EMEA Operations team – keep tracking and reporting current, run the internal cadence, and unblock cross-team dependencies so the team can focus on delivery
Drive issues to closure – own problem-solving and decision-making across teams and sites

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

2+ years in technical program management or engineering within automotive or embedded industry, ideally with hands-on experience at an OEM
Strong customer-facing presence; comfortable representing Applied Intuition independently with senior stakeholders
Technical depth in embedded systems, middleware, or ADAS – enough to assess feasibility and engage engineers credibly
Ability to operate independently across sites and time zones, including a reliable working overlap with our Sunnyvale teams
Stockholm- or Munich-based; or open to relocation

Nice To Have

Prior experience in a startup or high-growth environment.
Familiarity with automotive development standards (ASPICE, ISO 26262, AUTOSAR).

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.location: North Sydney, New South Wales, Australia
jobs.description:
Company Description

Smart Commercial Energy is an independent commercial solar and battery storage provider delivering complex energy solutions for businesses across Australia. We design and build large-scale solar, battery and energy projects for some of Australia’s best-known organisations, with a focus on technical excellence, commercial outcomes and doing the job properly.
With a growing pipeline of multi-site, multi-MW and complex energy projects, this is an exciting time to join our Projects team. We’re a smart, experienced and genuinely collaborative bunch, and we’re looking for people who want to take ownership and make a real impact.

Role Description

This is a full-time Senior Project Manager role based in our North Sydney office, with hybrid flexibility and regular site travel.

You’ll take end-to-end ownership of a portfolio of Smart’s largest and most complex commercial solar projects, typically from 500kW through to multi-MW, including multi-site programs, ground-mount installations and battery energy storage projects.
This is a senior delivery role with genuine commercial and technical accountability. You’ll own project scope, contracts, budgets, margin, programs, risk and client outcomes, while providing senior technical oversight across design, construction, commissioning and handover.

You’ll also act as a senior escalation point for the wider Projects team, providing guidance and mentoring to Project Managers and Project Engineers and helping lift delivery standards as our portfolio grows.

Key responsibilities include:
Owning the financial, commercial and delivery performance of a portfolio of major projects.
Managing contracts, variations, claims, subcontractors, procurement and commercial negotiations.
Leading project programs, resourcing, risk management and recovery strategies.
Providing senior technical oversight across PV, BESS, grid connection, structural and construction requirements.
Ensuring projects meet Australian standards, CEC guidelines, DNSP requirements and Smart’s quality and safety standards.
Leading commissioning, handover and project close-out.
Building strong relationships with senior client stakeholders, contractors and suppliers.
Supporting and mentoring Project Managers and Project Engineers, and acting as a senior escalation point for complex issues.
Reporting portfolio performance, financials, risks and delivery status to the Program Head.
Driving continuous improvement across project delivery, processes and tools.
Contributing technical and commercial input to tenders and pre-construction planning.

Qualifications

7+ years’ project management experience, with substantial experience delivering commercial solar projects from 500kW upwards.
Demonstrated experience with multi-MW, multi-site and/or ground-mount solar projects. BESS experience is highly regarded.
Strong commercial and contract management experience, including variations, claims, extensions of time and subcontractor management.
Deep understanding of the Australian electricity industry, photovoltaic systems and grid-connected energy projects.
Strong understanding of technical, structural, electrical and grid connection requirements for commercial solar.
Demonstrated ability to manage complex technical, commercial and delivery issues independently.
Excellent financial, organisational and project planning skills, with experience managing multiple major projects simultaneously.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience working with senior clients and executive stakeholders.
Engineering, construction management or related tertiary qualification, or equivalent industry experience.
CEC accreditation for grid-connected system design is highly regarded.
PMP, PRINCE2 or similar project management qualification is desirable.
High proficiency in Microsoft Office and project scheduling tools such as Microsoft Project.

Benefits

Competitive salary package and career development opportunities.
Hybrid flexibility and a family-friendly workplace.
Work on major commercial solar and battery projects across Australia.
A talented, experienced and supportive Projects team.
Learning and Development budget for professional growth.
Employee Assistance Program with six free counselling sessions per year.
Award-winning employer with a strong culture and a track record of delivering innovative energy projects.
North Sydney office, four minutes from Victoria Cross Metro and eight minutes from North Sydney Station.
Paid parking available on site if required.

jobs.title: Senior Security Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

We're looking for an experienced and driven Senior Security Technical Program Manager to join Snap's Security Programs and Compliance Engineering (SPACE)
Team. This pivotal role is focused on establishing a mature, enterprise-wide cybersecurity framework essential for protecting our global user base, employees, and partners. You'll be the instrumental driver of the program for security: metrics, governance, operating cadence, cross-functional execution, and leadership accountability for security maturity outcomes.

What you’ll do:

Lead the design, build, and ongoing operation of security operations and risk programs that improve cyber maturity across core security foundations, including governance, intake, prioritization, escalation, and remediation follow-through.
Define and operationalize security KRIs, KPIs, and health metrics across key domains such as vulnerability management, incident response, detection and response effectiveness, control performance, remediation timeliness, and recurring risk themes.
Establish a consistent measurement framework, dashboarding model, and reporting taxonomy so security leaders can review trends, identify material gaps, and drive accountable action across their teams.
Prepare and present regular business reviews for security leadership that translate technical signals into clear risk narratives, decisions, priorities, and follow-up actions.
Build the operating cadence for security team leadership, including program reviews, metric reviews, escalation forums, and quarterly planning rhythms that connect strategy to execution.
Establish a common organizational framework for security team OKRs, including goal setting, dependency management, milestone tracking, evidence of progress, and end-of-quarter readouts.
Partner across Security, Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, and Operations to align program priorities, resolve blockers, and ensure consistent execution of risk reduction workstreams.
Drive root-cause analysis and remediation governance for significant operational issues, ensuring lessons learned are translated into durable process, technology, or control improvements.
Create and maintain a portfolio view of security initiatives, risks, dependencies, and commitments, and use that view to support prioritization, staffing discussions, and leadership tradeoff decisions.
Define standard methods for risk intake, issue tracking, exception handling, escalation thresholds, and verified closure to improve consistency across the security organization.
Improve the rigor of security operations by identifying opportunities for workflow simplification, automation, and better decision support, reducing toil while increasing transparency and accountability.
Develop executive-ready briefing materials, scorecards, and narratives that clearly communicate program status, emerging risks, mitigation plans, and areas requiring leadership intervention.
Monitor program performance over time and recommend changes to operating models, metrics, and review mechanisms to continuously raise the maturity of security operations and risk management practices.

Knowledge, skills, & abilities:

Depth of security experience and familiarity with a broad range of information security concepts and principles
Proven experience of running critical programs within a security field
Experience working with engineers, driving large security projects that have had a proven impact
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with mastery in the ability to tailor the message to the audience
Experience influencing teams and other cross-functional stakeholders to drive security programs
Proficiency in, or a strong aptitude for, leveraging AI tools to streamline development, paired with the critical judgment to audit generated output for architectural integrity, performance bottlenecks, and security risks.
Adaptability in learning and applying evolving AI systems and tools to remain at the forefront of engineering trends and modern development practices.

Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field or equivalent experience
6+ years of experience in security advisory space, technical program management or security solution delivery

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with with NIST CSF 2.0, NIS2, or ISO 27001
Experience with CISSP, CISM, CCSP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or similar certifications a plus

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.

"Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.

At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, where applicable).

Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long-term success!

The successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. The starting pay may be negotiable within the salary range for the position. These pay zones may be modified in the future.

The base salary range for this position is $190,000-$284,000 annually.

The base salary range for this position is $181,000-$270,000 annually.

Why Join GEICO?

At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Drive issues to closure – own problem-solving and decision-making across teams and sites

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

2+ years in technical program management or engineering within automotive or embedded industry, ideally with hands-on experience at an OEM
Strong customer-facing presence; comfortable representing Applied Intuition independently with senior stakeholders
Technical depth in embedded systems, middleware, or ADAS – enough to assess feasibility and engage engineers credibly

Stockholm- or Munich-based; or open to relocation

Prior experience in a startup or high-growth environment.
Familiarity with automotive development standards (ASPICE, ISO 26262, AUTOSAR).

jobs.title: Agentic AI Program Manager
jobs.description:
What You'll Do

Canadian Tire is building a foundational Agentic AI platform to enable teams across the enterprise to design, deploy, govern, and scale AI agents safely and responsibly. We are looking for an Agentic AI Program Manager to lead the program execution, stakeholder alignment, delivery governance, and people leadership required to mature this capability from foundational build-out to enterprise adoption.

This is not a hands-on technical engineering role. However, the successful candidate must be comfortable working with technical, architecture, security, governance, data, cloud, vendor, and business teams. They should understand the business purpose of Agentic AI platform capabilities such as orchestration, identity, secure integrations, observability, evaluation, cost management, lifecycle management, and responsible AI governance.

The role will help ensure Canadian Tire’s Agentic AI platform is developed as a reusable enterprise capability, not a one-off implementation. Internal platform direction includes capabilities such as AI control plane, data ontology, semantic knowledge graph, tokenomics, AI development platform, AgentOps, and AI interaction security.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the enterprise program responsible for building and maturing Canadian Tire’s foundational Agentic AI platform.
Manage integrated plans, milestones, risks, dependencies, decision logs, status reporting, and executive communications.
Coordinate across architecture, engineering, security, privacy, AI governance, data, cloud, infrastructure, vendor, and business stakeholders.
Support platform readiness and adoption, including onboarding materials, delivery playbooks, operating models, and path-to-production guidance.
Partner with technical teams to understand current and emerging platform capabilities, including Microsoft Foundry, agent hosting, identity integration, model access, observability, networking, and CI/CD evolution.
Track and escalate key delivery dependencies and platform maturity gaps, including items such as APIM, hosted agent libraries, ACR, evaluation framework, and environment readiness where applicable.
Provide clear, concise updates to senior leaders on progress, risks, trade-offs, funding considerations, decisions required, and future roadmap needs.
Monitor industry adoption of Agentic AI and help shape future platform capabilities and operating models for Canadian Tire.
Lead, coach, and support team members or matrixed contributors working across the Agentic AI program.

Required

What you bring

Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional technology, transformation, platform, or enterprise delivery programs.
Strong program management discipline, including roadmap planning, RAID management, executive reporting, dependency tracking, and governance cadence.
Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and create structure across fast-moving initiatives.
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical topics into business and executive-level messaging.
Experience working with technical teams, architecture, security, governance, vendors, and senior stakeholders.
People leadership experience, either directly or through matrixed delivery teams.
Strong understanding of enterprise technology delivery, agile planning, release management, governance, and platform operating models.

Preferred

Experience in AI, data, cloud, automation, digital transformation, or enterprise platform programs.
Familiarity with Agentic AI, generative AI, AI agents, AI governance, responsible AI, cloud platforms, APIs, and integration patterns.
Exposure to Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Foundry, Databricks, API management, or enterprise AI platforms.
Experience developing onboarding models, operating playbooks, adoption frameworks, or technology governance processes.
Experience in a large enterprise environment with multiple business, technology, vendor, and governance stakeholders.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a structured, outcome-oriented program leader who can bring clarity to a fast-evolving space. They do not need to design the technical architecture, but they must be curious enough to understand the platform, ask the right questions, identify gaps, and communicate implications clearly.

They are comfortable engaging with architects, engineers, vendors, governance teams, and senior executives. They can manage near-term delivery while helping shape the longer-term roadmap for how Canadian Tire should adopt and evolve Agentic AI responsibly and at scale.

We’re always looking for great talent! In addition to competitive pay, we offer:

Comprehensive benefits and retirement programs
Performance incentives, Continuing Education Programs
Other perks to support your well-being
Career growth opportunities and product discounts

We are seeking an experienced Senior PX Program Manager to lead the delivery, optimization, adoption, and continuous improvement of strategic Talent Acquisition (TA) programs and priority People Experience (PX) initiatives. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in program and project management, process improvement, change management, and stakeholder engagement, along with experience supporting Talent Acquisition or other high-volume People functions. This is a full-time role responsible for advancing critical TA and PX priorities, strengthening operating rigor, and developing efficient, repeatable approaches that support organizational growth.

CIP delivers world-class automated experiences across CS Home Page, CS Chatbot, CS Voicebot, and emerging integrations such as Alexa+ by predicting the Intent of customers in order to serve them better when they reach out to Amazon. Description

You will own the end-to-end delivery of network infrastructure at scale — from customer demand signal through manufacturing, shipping, and site landing — ensuring the world's largest cloud network gets built on time. This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role where you directly influence whether critical network capacity arrives when customers need it.

Key job responsibilities

Why This Role

You own outcomes, not tasks. CDR operates at the intersection of supply chain, network engineering, and program execution — you'll drive delivery across all of them.

You'll lead through ambiguity. When demand shifts, vendors miss, or builds slip, you're the one who finds the path forward.

What You'll Do

Drive delivery performance across network rack demand streams (Bricks, Spines, Loose Gear, Scaling, New DC) from order through site installation

Own stakeholder communication for delivery status, risks, and blockers — proactively surfacing issues before they become escalations.

Manage cross-functional dependencies across procurement, manufacturing, logistics, construction, and network deployment teams.

Identify systemic bottlenecks and drive structural improvements.

Partner with automation and data engineering teams to scale delivery insights through tooling

What You'll Bring

Track record of program-managing complex, multi-stakeholder hardware or infrastructure delivery at scale.

Ability to synthesize across data sources and present the "so what" — not just the status.

Comfort operating in ambiguity with incomplete information and competing priorities.

Strong written communication: you produce artifacts that drive decisions without requiring follow-up questions.

Bias toward mechanisms over heroics — you build systems that make the next delivery easier, not just this one.

A day in the life

Your morning starts with a miss that threatens a site deadline — you assess impact and draft the recovery path before your first meeting. Mid-day, you're connecting supply chain signals across procurement, manufacturing, and logistics to catch cascading risks early. You prep a delivery narrative for leadership where the goal is zero follow-up questions. You close the day unblocking your team and documenting the pattern so it doesn't take heroics next time.

You're executing today's deliveries while building the mechanisms that make tomorrow's easier.

The CDR Networking team ensures on-time delivery of critical networking hardware — racks, optics, and loose gear — that connects every AWS service to the backbone. We operate at the intersection of supply chain, manufacturing, and network engineering, owning delivery end-to-end from customer order through site landing. Our culture is built on transparency, disciplined execution, and continuous improvement. This is not an easy job. Our customers are demanding. The timelines are short. The constraints are real. The means we challenge the status quo, proceduralize what's repeatable, automate what's possible, and focus our people on the problems that actually require their expertise. As an Executive Office Strategic Operations Manager, you will play a pivotal role in driving strategic initiatives and projects within our Internal Firm Services practice. You will support leaders by managing key responsibilities, representing their perspectives in meetings, and anticipating their future needs. This role involves organizing leadership team calls and meetings, overseeing research and data analysis, and promoting consistent execution across sectors. You will collaborate across lines of service to facilitate knowledge sharing and promote technology and tools for sales and delivery.

As a Manager, you will enhance your leadership style by motivating, developing, and inspiring others to deliver quality outcomes. You are responsible for coaching and leveraging team members' unique strengths while managing performance to meet expectations. With your growing business acumen, you will identify opportunities that contribute to the success of our firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values meaningfully. Embracing technology and innovation, you will enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same. In this role, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion.

Responsibilities

Managing strategic initiatives and projects to support leadership in achieving organizational goals
Coordinating and organizing leadership team meetings and calls to facilitate effective communication and decision-making
Overseeing research and data analysis to provide insights and support strategic planning
Promoting consistent execution across sectors by collaborating with various lines of service
Utilizing digital tools and technology to enhance operational efficiency and delivery
Handling confidential information with discretion and professionalism
Developing and mentoring team members to leverage their strengths and improve performance
Addressing conflicts and engaging in constructive conversations with stakeholders to resolve issues
Tracking and reporting on project progress to maintain alignment with strategic objectives
Encouraging innovation and embracing change to drive continuous improvement in operations

At least a High School Diploma or the equivalent degree
At least 4 years of experience

Preference for a Master of Arts or a Master's of Business Administration degree in at least one of the following fields of study: Business Administration/Management,Data Processing/Analytics/Science,Economics,Analytics

Leveraging digital tooling for operational execution

jobs.description:
Requisition Number: 30323

Required Travel: 11 - 25%

Employment Type: Full Time/Salaried/Exempt

Anticipated Salary Range: $143,088.00 - $190,000.00

Security Clearance: Ability to Obtain

Level of Experience: Management

This opportunity resides with Global Security (GS).
Mission Technologies’ Global Security (GS) group comprises live, virtual, constructive (LVC) solutions; fleet sustainment; nuclear and environmental; and Australia business.

As a trusted partner to our military customers, HII designs, develops and operates the largest LVC enterprise that prepares warfighters for cross-domain battle. With advanced technologies to enable mission readiness, HII understands that preparation requires full coordination—not readiness in piece-parts.

For more than 40 years, the U.S. Navy has entrusted HII to maintain and modernize the vast majority of its fleet. With a holistic approach to life-cycle maritime defense systems—from small watercraft to submarines, surface combatants and aircraft carriers—HII ensures a high state of readiness.

HII supports the Department of Energy’s national security mission through the management and operation of its sites, as well as the safe cleanup of legacy waste across the country. HII meets clients’ toughest nuclear and environmental challenges.

Leadership at HII – Mission Technologies

Role

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

Know & Grow Your People – Develop talent, empower teams, and build an inclusive environment.
Build Relationships – Strengthen trust, collaboration, and cross-functional partnerships.
Take Ownership – Drive accountability, execution excellence, and results.
Customer First – Anticipate mission needs and deliver value to our partners.
Shape the Future – Inspire innovation and align work with strategic priorities.
Act with Urgency – Make informed decisions and move with purpose.

These capabilities define how leaders inspire teams, deliver results, and shape the future of Mission Technologies.

Summary

Join a mission‑driven team supporting Fleet Sustainment as our Senior Fabrication Program Manager, a senior leader shaping and driving all fabrication operations across the organization. Reporting directly to the VP of Operations, this role leads the full lifecycle of fabrication activity, including strategic make/buy decisions, production oversight, and continuous improvement of operations.

We’re looking for a hands‑on, highly skilled fabrication expert who thrives in fast‑paced operational environments, demonstrates an unwavering commitment to safety and quality, and brings strong familiarity with U.S. Navy standards, work environments, and customer expectations. This is a high‑impact position with visibility across leadership, customers, and industry partners.

Essential Job Responsibilities

Champion a culture of integrity, safety, quality, respect, and accountability in all fabrication operations.
Lead planning, execution, and performance across complex metal fabrication, piping, and sheetmetal work packages, ensuring cost, schedule, and technical objectives are met.
Develop comprehensive Statements of Work for work-items being outsourced.
Direct day to day operational execution for multiple fabrication projects, serving as the central point of coordination between planning, production, engineering, and leadership.
Efficiently manage workload distribution, scheduling, and task assignments across multiple fabrication programs/projects.
Monitor performance, budgets, and schedules; prepare clear, actionable reports and present updates to internal teams and external customers.
Build and maintain strong relationships with Navy customers and subcontractors to grow existing markets and seek new opportunities.
Identify and resolve project challenges proactively, driving improvements in productivity, quality, and customer satisfaction.
Develop and implement systems for performance monitoring, problem resolution, and project optimization.
Provide hands on operational support when needed to resolve technical issues or meet critical deadlines.
Create and maintain technical documentation including controlled work packages, procedures, test documents, and trip reports.
Recommend enhancements to policies and processes to support improved safety, efficiency, and operational results.
Lead, mentor, and develop team members through clear communication, performance guidance, and mission focused direction.
Ensure all projects meet budget, schedule, and performance targets, preventing rework, delays, and cost impacts.

Minimum Qualifications

8 years relevant progressive experience with Bachelors in related field; 6 years relevant progressive experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 12 years relevant progressive experience.
Demonstrated expertise in a wide range of DoD contract types, including CPIF, CPFF, FPIF, and FFP, with the ability to interpret contract requirements, assess cost and schedule impacts, and ensure compliance throughout execution.
Skilled in preparing and submitting Condition Found Reports, accurately identifying growth work, and coordinating with program managers to validate scope, develop estimates, and support timely resolution.
Experienced in end to end change order management, including scope definition, impact analysis, proposal development, negotiation support, and incorporation of approved changes into cost, schedule, and performance baselines.
Strong, practical knowledge of fabrication operations including welding processes, paint booth and blasting operations, and metalworking equipment such as shear, brake, and plasma tables; proficiency in safe operation of fabrication equipment.
Formal experience with quality assurance programs to include executing work under NAVSEA Standard Items and Joint Fleet Maintenance Manual (JFMM).
Ability to interpret NAVSEA technical documentation, standards, and procedures for naval structural installations, welding, and painting; with demonstrated ability to apply ABS Rules, AWS/ASME welding and fabrication codes, and commercial/industry standards as shop work expands beyond Navy programs.
Experience estimating and planning fabrication bids.
Ability to qualify, manage, and evaluate fabrication subcontractors, machine shops, paint vendors, and structural fabricators for outsourced work.
Proven experience leading teams performing project based work in industrial environments with ability to deliver results through direct reports and lower level supervisors.
Strong proficiency in standard computer applications including word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, and email.
Effective communication skills with teams, leadership, and customers.
Ability to enforce and comply with safety protocols.
Must be able to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret clearance and base access credentials.
U.S. Citizenship required.

Preferred Requirements

Experience managing welding fabrication operations.
Experience overseeing paint and coatings operations.
Familiarity with multiple welding processes.
Knowledge/experience with SubSafe / Level 1 requirements.
Ability to interpret drawings and models in CAD or similar tools for fabrication planning.
Ability to lead make/buy decisions using cost benefit analysis, schedule impact evaluations, and vendor capability assessments.
Familiarity with introducing new fabrication technologies (e.g., CNC plasma programming, robotic welding, improved coatings systems).
Shipboard experience strongly preferred.
Understanding of Navy operations, environments, and mission requirements.

Physical Requirements

Job performance may require working in an industrial or shipboard environment. Normally not required to lift more than 40 pounds higher than three feet above feet/floor level.

Program Manager
jobs.description:
Description

Program Manager:

At B&A, we foster and embrace a distinct set of values that we live by and instill in all aspects of our organization: dedication, commitment, partnership, trust, and recognition. We have incorporated these values into successful delivery for our customers since 1988. B&A believes in ensuring its employees feel deeply connected to B&A, recognizing successes and hard work, and providing continuous opportunities to learn and grow. Our people are entrepreneurial thinkers that combine mindset, vision, and experience to drive value – not only to us as an organization, but to the clients we support. We promote a collaborative culture with our clients, and with each other, as one team working towards a common vision. We’d love for you to join our team!

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Program Manager
to lead a large-scale, enterprise Human Capital Management support program for the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA). The Program Manager will provide strategic leadership, operational oversight, and contract management across multiple NGA locations, ensuring high-quality delivery of human resources services, compliance with contractual requirements, and continuous process improvement.

This role serves as the primary interface between contractor leadership and NGA stakeholders, including the Contracting Officer (CO), Contracting Officer's Representative (COR), Human Development (HD) leadership, and senior Government executives. The successful candidate will possess extensive human resources management experience, federal contracting expertise, and a demonstrated ability to lead geographically dispersed teams supporting mission-critical operations within the Intelligence Community.

Responsibilities

Serve as the primary point of contact to the Contracting Officer, the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR), and HD leadership for all program matters.
Manage technical, financial, and contractual performance, including staffing and responses to every tasking.

jobs.title: Sr Project Manager, Client Connectivity-Innovation Banking
jobs.description:
In compliance with applicable laws, HSBC is committed to employing only those who are authorized to work in the US. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. as HSBC will not engage in immigration sponsorship for this position.

Our purpose – Opening up a world of opportunity – explains why we exist. Here at HSBC we use our unique expertise, capabilities, breadth and perspectives to open up new kinds of opportunity for our more than 40 million customers. We’re bringing together the people, ideas and capital that nurture progress and growth, helping to create a better world – for our customers, our people, our investors, our communities and the planet we all share.

This role sits at the intersection of solution architecture, technical implementation, and project delivery for HSBC’s client connectivity channels. You’ll design and deliver technically robust, secure, and scalable connectivity solutions for strategic corporate clients, leading complex onboarding and change initiatives across HSBCnet, APIs, SWIFT connectivity, and Host-to-Host (H2H)/file-based connectivity.

You’ll run technical discovery and client workshops, convert business outcomes into technical designs, define testing and cutover approaches (including ISO 20022 formats and SWIFT migration considerations), and then drive end-to-end execution—removing blockers across client teams, Product, IT, Client Service and Coverage/Sales. The goal: faster time-to-revenue, high-quality implementations, and smooth client experience.

As our Sr Project Manager, Client Connectivity-Innovation Banking, you will:

Own the end-to-end technical approach for client connectivity implementations, including architecture decisions, sequencing, and technical artefacts
Lead technical client workshops to document current-state processes and define target-state automation across:
Accounts Payable, Receivables, Treasury, Payroll
Bank statements and technical reconciliation

Design connectivity solutions across:
APIs, SWIFT connectivity (connected banking patterns, security considerations, technical trade-offs)
H2H/file-based connectivity (format management, transmission patterns, operational controls) and HSBCnet channel alignment as required

Translate client requirements into clear technical deliverables (data mapping, message specifications, control points, exception handling)
Document agreed solutions clearly, including statements of work, technical scope, assumptions, dependencies, and controls
Lead practical implementation of ISO 20022 for payments and reporting message formats, including mapping, validation, and exception handling
Ensure solution designs account for industry evolution, including SWIFT MT to MX migration impacts and de-risking plans for corporate clients
Support testing of payment and receivables files in industry-accepted formats, coordinating across global stakeholders where required
Lead end-to-end delivery: planning, execution and cutover, with a strong emphasis on technical risk control
Partner closely with Project Management disciplines, while personally driving: Technical workstream governance, checkpoints, testing strategy, cutover planning along with critical care for customers post go live
Identify technical blockers (format issues, mapping gaps, environment constraints) and drive resolution to protect timelines and outcomes
Monitor post-launch connectivity performance and stability; identify optimization opportunities and implement continuous improvements
Provide pre-mandate technical support for RFI/RFP responses and solution proposals; act as a consultative partner to Coverage/Sales
Serve as liaison across Client Service, Sales/Coverage, Product and IT, aligning global/regional/country stakeholders on a single delivery path
Act as a trusted advisor to client technology and treasury stakeholders—confidently leading workshops and senior stakeholder discussions

You´ll likely have the following skills to succeed in this role:

Deep experience in client-facing solutioning and technical delivery: solution architecture, implementation, or technical consulting within banking/payments/treasury/fintech
Hands-on delivery of connectivity implementations using H2H/file-based and/or API-based technical; able to clearly explain trade-offs and fit-for-purpose recommendations
Strong working knowledge of payments and connectivity, including:
ACH, wires, real-time/instant payments
ISO 20022 standards and real delivery experience (mapping/testing/validation)
SWIFT connectivity and ability to discuss MT→MX migration impacts

Proven ability to manage multiple complex workstreams and act as an escalation point, with strong stakeholder influence across business and technology teams
Excellent communication skills—able to translate between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders without losing accuracy
Familiarity with client platforms and technical patterns:
ERPs: SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics
TMS awareness: Kyriba, GTreasury, FIS Quantum, Integrity

Experience supporting global or multi-country client rollouts; comfort operating in multicultural teams and time zones
Working knowledge of treasury operating models, centralization/standardization initiatives, and change management practices
Comfortable with structured delivery and transparency via tools such as JIRA, MS Project, Confluence (or equivalents)
Project management certification (PMP/Prince2/Agile) is advantageous but not required—what matters is disciplined delivery and predictable outcomes

As an HSBC employee, you will have access to tailored professional development opportunities to ensure you have the right skills for today and tomorrow. We offer a competitive pay and benefits package including a robust Wellness Hub, all in a welcoming and inclusive work environment. You will be empowered to drive HSBC’s engagement with the communities we serve through an industry-leading volunteerism policy, a generous matching gift program, and a comprehensive program of immersive Sustainability and Climate Change Initiatives. You’ll want to join our Employee Resource Groups as they play a central part in life at HSBC, including the development of our employees and networking inside and outside of HSBC. We value difference. We succeed together. We take responsibility. We get it done. And we want you to help us build the bank of the future!

jobs.description:
Methode Electronics is a global leader in innovative electronic solutions, serving industries such as automotive, industrial, aerospace, and consumer electronics. With a strong commitment to engineering excellence, quality, and continuous innovation, Methode delivers cutting-edge technologies that power today’s most advanced products. Our collaborative culture and focus on professional growth empower employees to make a meaningful impact while building rewarding careers. Joining Methode means being part of a forward-thinking team that values integrity, creativity, and driving the future of technology.

Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Strategy Analyst to support the development and execution of our global growth strategy. This role will leverage market research, competitive intelligence, financial modeling, and data analytics to identify growth opportunities, evaluate strategic investments, and provide actionable insights that inform business decisions. Working cross-functionally with Product Management, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Engineering, and regional business leaders, the Strategy Analyst will transform complex internal and external data into clear recommendations that strengthen competitive positioning, drive profitable growth, and support long-term strategic objectives across the automotive and mobility landscape.

Responsibilities

Market Intelligence & Strategic Analysis: Gather, validate, and analyze automotive market, customer, and industry data to identify trends, growth opportunities, market attractiveness, and strategic implications. Support development of "Where to Play" and "How to Win" recommendations across products, technologies, and end markets.
Competitive & Industry Research: Monitor competitor activities, including product launches, technology developments, partnerships, and financial performance. Maintain competitive intelligence dashboards and provide insights on market positioning and emerging industry dynamics.
Financial Modeling & Business Case Development: Build and maintain financial models to support market sizing, forecasting, profitability analysis, cost-benefit assessments, investment evaluations, and strategic business cases.
Data Analytics & Insight Generation: Transform complex internal and external datasets into actionable insights through quantitative analysis, dashboard development, and performance reporting to support strategic decision-making.
Executive Communications & Strategic Storytelling: Develop executive-ready presentations, reports, visualizations, and recommendations that effectively communicate findings, opportunities, risks, and strategic priorities to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Emerging Technology & Special Projects: Conduct ad hoc research on automotive and mobility trends, including electrification, autonomous driving, connected vehicles, software-defined vehicles, and other disruptive technologies. Support strategic initiatives and special projects as needed.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field; MBA preferred.
2+ years of experience in Strategy, Corporate Development, Business Analytics, Consulting, Finance, Market Research, or a similar analytical role.
Experience in performing market analysis, competitive intelligence, financial modeling, and business case development.
Strong understanding of strategic planning, forecasting, profitability analysis, and investment evaluation.
Advanced Excel proficiency, including financial modeling, Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, and data analysis tools.
Experience with Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or other analytics and visualization tools is a plus.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
Automotive, mobility, manufacturing, or technology industry experience preferred.
Self-starter with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
